```flowproof
workflow critic_loop
  needs task: text
  role author can edit
  role critic can answer
  budget at most 5 calls

  var change = edit author: "{task}"
  var approved = false
  repeat at most 2 until approved
    set approved = ask critic: """
      Task: {task}
      Proposed change:
      {change.patch}
      Is this change acceptable for the task? Answer yes or no.
      """ as bool
    if not approved
      set change = edit author: """
        Task: {task}
        The critic rejected the change below. Revise it to satisfy the task.
        {change.patch}
        """
    end
  end
  give change
end
```
